description: Installation of Pulsehub with integrated digital screens and emergency functionality including provision of a defibrillator
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-85bfe372-7fff-b991-35c0-7749d9d506bb"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The introduction of the proposed PulseHub introduces unnecessary distraction for drivers, contrary to highway safety. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D8 (Public realm) and T2 (Healthy streets) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP7 (Advertisements), LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods), and LP42 (Walking and Cycling) of Hackney’s Local Development Plan (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-10bdbc36-7fff-4a34-52cf-9f6a4a88637a"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed PulseHub, by reason of its size, scale, detailed design and appearance, and illumination, featuring a moving digital display, would result in an obtrusive and visually incongruous feature that contributes to an unsightly proliferation and clutter of signage and street furniture in the local area that would detract from the design, character, and appearance of the surrounding area. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design), and D8 (Public realm) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP1 (High Quality Design), and LP7 (Advertisements) of Hackney's Local Development Plan LP33 (2020), and the </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Public Realm Strategy SPD (2012).</span></span></p>
